scope.common_norm: For a lifted cylinder f, ||f||_infinity is the supremum over all sufficiently large G_n and all declared finite configurations. The root-weighted interaction seminorm is ||f||_(cyl,w)=sup_(n,omega) sum_{r:Delta_r f_n(omega)!=0} w(r)|f_n(r omega)-f_n(omega)|.

scope.root_support_rule: For each PAH root r, supp(r) is the maximal vertex closure of every PAH energy term that can change under r: phase roots use the incident vertex star, aperture roots use the closed two-cell star of the vertex, radial-transfer roots use the closed two-cell star of both endpoints, and link roots use the closed two-cell star of the link and its incident faces. This support is geometric and state-independent.
scope.root_weight: w(r)=1+|supp(r)|, a positive integer derived only from the geometric support cardinality; it changes no PAH rate.
